_comment: Lines the assistant says without a language model: questions with one truthful answer, and common turns when no model is available. Keyed by Gnani locale code; a code with no entry uses the same prefix, then en-IN. Hinglish and Benglish are written in the native script with English words, which Timbre reads better. The assistant voice is female. No digits.
